description: A 16:9 diagram in three vertical layers. Left: one tall rounded box 'Ask Rasoi (host)' containing a smaller box 'LLM'. Right of it, two server boxes stacked with a gap: top 'Rasoi toolbox' with a sky-blue border, bottom 'Supplier directory (third party)' with an ember-orange border. Under the Rasoi toolbox box, a short arrow down to an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP'; Bahi ERP connects ONLY to the Rasoi toolbox, never to the host. Two arrows join the host and each server box. Around the picture, four numbered callout cards, each with a title line in ember orange and a second line in sky blue: card 1 placed next to the third-party server: '1 Tool poisoning: orders hidden in a tool description' / 'pin reviewed descriptions'; card 2 placed under the third-party server: '2 Injection in tool output: a quote that gives orders' / 'treat results as data, hold writes for the person'; card 3 placed above the Rasoi toolbox: '3 Confused deputy: a server running as SVC_AGENT' / 'bind every request to the signed-in user'; card 4 placed between the host and the Rasoi toolbox: '4 Over-broad scope: one token that can do everything' / 'least scope per agent'. No other text. Labels as plain text, no brackets except '(host)' and '(third party)'.

A 16:9 architecture diagram with three columns. Middle column, top to bottom: a green strip 'Sign-in: OAuth 2.1 token, the person's own session'; below it a large rounded sky-blue box 'Rasoi toolbox: MCP server' containing three small white chips 'tools', 'resources', 'prompts'; below it an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)' joined to the toolbox by a vertical line. Left column: four host boxes stacked vertically, 'Ask Rasoi', 'Claude Desktop', 'VS Code and Cursor', 'n8n workflows'; from each host box one straight arrow points right into the toolbox box, and each arrow is labelled 'MCP'. Right column: a dashed rectangle titled 'Deccan Polymers, another company' containing one box 'Deccan sales agent'. One curved sky-blue double-headed arrow goes from the top host box 'Ask Rasoi' over the top of the toolbox to 'Deccan sales agent', labelled 'A2A'. Labels as plain text, no brackets except '(1998)'.
